description: Divisional Secretariat - Matara Four Gravets - Norifying that the Annual Festival of Mother's National Church, Matara on 31.08.2017 to 10.09.2017
categorisation: The gazette content announces the dates for the Annual Festival of Mother's National Church in Matara under the Pilgrimage Ordinance (Chapter 175). This constitutes a regulatory matter involving the implementation of existing legislation (the Pilgrimage Ordinance) and falls under legal/regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
